content: ▪️ Chevron, Qatar-based UCC Holding, and the Syrian Petroleum Company have identified an offshore block for Syria’s first deep-water oil and gas exploration project. ▪️ The project is part of efforts to attract foreign investment into Syria’s energy sector following years of war and sanctions. ▪️ The Syrian Petroleum Company said the step follows a preliminary agreement signed in February to evaluate offshore exploration in Syrian waters. ▪️ The move marks an initial phase toward technical preparation and potential development of offshore resources in the eastern Mediterranean. Source: Reuters

content: Hezbollah's military structure is precisely and regionally divided, with each unit operating in a specific area with defined operational duties. In this post, we intend to learn more about the units of the heroic Hezbollah. ⚫ Haidar Unit Deployment location: Northern Lebanon and areas north of the Litani River Mission: Strategic deployment in northern areas and creation of initial defensive layers 🔴 Beirut Unit Deployment location: Beirut city and surrounding areas Mission: Managing organizational presence and structural activities in the capital ⚪ Badr Unit Deployment location: Beqaa Valley and central sections Mission: Serving as the center of gravity for command, fire control, defense, and weapons storage 🟢 Nasser Unit Deployment location: Southern Lebanon, especially the Nabatieh axis Mission: Operational support, field deployment, and strengthening southern lines 🟡 Aziz Unit Deployment location: Southwestern Lebanon, especially the Tyre region Mission: Weapons maintenance and management of short-range rocket launch infrastructure ⚔️ Radwan Unit (Special Force) Deployment location: North of Litani, Beqaa, and active presence in Southern Lebanon Mission: Carrying out offensive operations, infiltration, and special ground and naval operations

Deputy Minister of Roads and Urban Development during a visit to Shajareh Tayebeh Primary School in Minab: Housing loan deposits for repairing and rebuilding homes damaged or destroyed in the war will be paid from 400 million to 2 billion Tomans. This loan, commensurate with the rates in counties, provincial capitals, and metropolitan areas, will be paid to property owners with established cases from the mortgage funds provided to housing banks. The construction of destroyed homes in metropolitan areas is the responsibility of municipalities, and in other counties of the country, it is spearheaded by the Housing Foundation.
headline: Housing Deposit Payment to War Victims
